body: The theorem of a good enough parent says that:

[indent][font="res://Assets/Font/JetBrainsMono.ttf"]
[color=#3A7AFE]if[/color] your reactions to your child’s needs == empathic in > 50% cases

    [color=#3A7AFE]then[/color]:

    you = good enough parent who stepped out of the black stream
[/font][/indent]

choices.label: You can just say it out loud, that I was a terrible mother.
